negative_findings.description: Searches for Slovenia-specific press releases from Nexi (Nexi Slovenija d.o.o.) returned only company-register and credit-rating aggregator pages — no Slovenian-language corporate newsroom for the local entity surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Nexi Slovenija appears to have no local press channel; announcements presumably flow only through Nexi Group (Italy) in English.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Slovenia-specific processing wins or restructurings at the second-largest local processor may be invisible unless group IR is monitored with full-text country filtering, or AJPES filings are read annually.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language Mastercard or Visa press release / newsroom page was located despite a local-language query using 'sporočilo za javnost'. Results were dominated by Slovenian banks' card terms and consumer FAQ pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Card scheme country announcements for Slovenia were not found on a local newsroom in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief expects card scheme country announcements; if none exist locally, coverage must be achieved via the schemes' global newsrooms with Slovenia keyword filters, which is lower-recall.

negative_findings.description: Bankart's 'Aktualno' newsroom lists only five items spanning 2020-2026, with no visible pagination or archive, and one item is titled generically 'SPOROČILO ZA JAVNOST' (26.3.2025).
negative_findings.result_summary: Official Bankart announcement volume is very low (roughly 1-2 items per year).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The processor at the centre of this cell does not use press releases as its main disclosure channel — annual reports, scheme rulebooks and merchant documentation carry far more signal, and the collection design must weight them accordingly.

negative_findings.description: Bankart annual reports and payment-system public disclosure documents were found only as direct wp-content PDF URLs surfaced by search engines; they are not linked from the current site navigation.
negative_findings.result_summary: No stable annual-report index page on bankart.si was identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A crawler following site navigation alone would miss the single richest quantitative source in this cell; discovery must combine sitemap/upload-path enumeration with AJPES.

negative_findings.description: Several URLs in this slice were assembled from search-result snippets rather than fetched in this pass (Nexi Group media index, Mastercard SI root, flik.si root, ECB TIPS index, EPC register, ZBS root, AJPES root, BSI National Payments Council index).

negative_findings.why_it_matters: The downstream deterministic verification pass must resolve these; a 403 or timeout on any of them should be treated as bot defence, not as a dead source.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Long-term monitoring needs the canonical bsi.si index; relying on a mirror risks silent breakage and version ambiguity.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian ATM/POS terminal estate operators and independent ATM deployers (e.g. bank-shared ATM networks) were not investigated; the cell focused on card processing and instant payments.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run local-language queries on 'bankomatska mreža', 'skupna mreža bankomatov', 'POS terminali najem' to identify terminal-estate actors and any shared-ATM joint ventures.

coverage_gaps.description: Fintech/PSP-licensed non-bank acquirers and payment institutions registered with Banka Slovenije were not enumerated, nor was the public register of payment institutions and e-money institutions retrieved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the Banka Slovenije public register of payment institutions / e-money institutions ('register plačilnih institucij', 'družbe za izdajo elektronskega denarja') and treat each entrant as a candidate actor.

coverage_gaps.description: Procurement and tender records were not searched. Bankart and the banks procure processing, HSM, terminal and gateway technology via tenders that reveal vendor selections ahead of any announcement.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search the Slovenian public procurement portal (eJN / Portal javnih naročil) and TED for payment-processing, POS terminal and card-personalisation lots, if the buyers fall within scope of procurement law.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth is weak: Bankart annual reports were only located for FY2019 and FY2020, and its newsroom archive appears truncated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Retrieve FY2021-FY2025 filings via AJPES JOLP and probe the Internet Archive for older bankart.si newsroom snapshots to rebuild a time series.

coverage_gaps.description: Bankart and flik.si were assessed mainly through Slovenian content; the extent and freshness of their English-language trees (relevant for pan-European counterpart monitoring) was not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check for /en/ mirrors on bankart.si and flik.si and record whether English content lags the Slovenian original, so collection is anchored on the authoritative language.

coverage_gaps.description: Worldline's and Nexi's Slovenian legal entities (if any beyond Nexi Slovenija d.o.o.) and their local filings were not resolved; only group-level newsrooms were captured for Worldline.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query the AJPES business register for Worldline-, Nets-, Six/Payone- and PayTen/Monri-affiliated entities registered in Slovenia to complete the local operator map.

brief: Slovenia's payments infrastructure layer is unusually concentrated and unusually quiet: Bankart d.o.o., owned by the banks, runs card issuing/acquiring processing plus the three designated payment systems (BIPS/BIPS-IP, SIMP-PS, card settlement) and operates the domestic Flik instant-payment scheme, while Nexi Slovenija d.o.o. (formerly Nets CEE / Mercury Processing / Intesa Sanpaolo Card) is the second processing pole. The highest-value disclosure is not press releases — Bankart publishes only about one or two a year — but its statutory annual reports and its mandatory payment-system public disclosure documents, neither of which is linked from site navigation and both of which therefore need PDF-path and AJPES-based discovery. The regulatory layer (Banka Slovenije oversight pages, the annual payment and settlement systems report, payment statistics reporting, and the National Payments Council e-newsletter) plus ZBS gives reliable, high-credibility coverage in Slovenian, and the EPC SCT Inst register plus ECB TIPS material covers scheme reachability from the European side. Pan-European acquirer coverage is real but low-recall: Worldline mentions Slovenia inside multi-country release bodies rather than in titles, and no Slovenian-language newsroom was found for Nexi Slovenija, Mastercard SI or Visa SI, so full-text country filtering of group newsrooms is required.
